note: The topics every command and state bridge shares. The prefix is the default; a bridge may be configured with another one. Direction is from the bridge: in = the bridge subscribes, out = the bridge publishes.

topics.purpose: A command for the bridge; a retained delivery is a replay by the broker and is ignored
A job; with the switch on it is signed, carries issued_at_ms and expires_in_ms and is refused otherwise
The answer to a command, including the refusal and its reason
The last known state of the machine behind the bridge
online once connected, offline as the Last Will (not maintained while the health topic is on)
The state of the bridge as a HealthReport; FAULT is its Last Will; off by default
The global stop: SAFE_STOP is retained and a bridge refuses to move while it holds; off by default
